profile_text.body:
IBM is a public company traded as IBM, with CIK 0000051143, founded in 1911 and headquartered in Armonk, NY. Its most recent annual filing, a 10-K covering the period ending 2025-12-31, reported revenue of $67,535,000,000. The material harvested from its site centers on IBM OpenPages, which IBM describes as a scalable, AI-powered governance, risk and compliance platform that runs on any cloud or on-premises and is sold as modules an organization can deploy individually.

Three products are tracked. IBM OpenPages with Watson is described as a full GRC platform with AI-specific modules for risk assessment and regulatory mapping. IBM watsonx.governance covers AI lifecycle governance, including model evaluation, monitoring and documentation, and is noted as a Leader in Gartner's first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant, dated June 2026. IBM watsonx is listed as an enterprise AI platform. The site says OpenPages can connect to watsonx.ai or third-party and custom models through an API-based architecture, offers a GRC Canvas workspace for modeling processes, risks and controls against live data, and includes an OpenPages MCP Server that lets AI agents create, query and update GRC objects. It also cites recognition in the IDC MarketScape Worldwide AI-Enabled Financial Governance, Risk, and Compliance 2026 Vendor Assessment and a partnership with Citi to automate internal audit work using AI and machine learning.

The litigation record associated with the company lists 448 matters in New York.
